description: Replace the project's declared print context with record_print_context. Partial inputs return missing fields. This does not edit the 3MF or independently verify a declaration.

fields.printer_model: Actual printer model, confirmed by the user. Compare with the saved profile.
fields.firmware_version: Installed printer firmware. Calibration and accessory support can depend on its version.
fields.build_plate: Actual plate product/surface and any adhesive or release layer. Do not infer it from the saved profile.
fields.environment: Actual enclosure, ventilation, ambient/chamber conditions and cooling arrangement. Leave measurements unknown when unavailable.
fields.intended_use: Required appearance, fit, load direction, service temperature and environment. Do not infer structural acceptance from appearance.
fields.nozzles: Active nozzles in project order. Each has diameter_mm (positive number), material and variant (text, including standard or high flow as appropriate).
fields.filaments: Actual spools in project assignment order. Each permits material, brand, product, color, drying, feeding_path, specification_url and calibration. feeding_path identifies external spool or the exact AMS model and feeding/dry-storage bypass mode. Record unknown for unavailable information. Never invent specifications.
fields.calibration: Optional filament object with temperature_c, max_volumetric_speed_mm3_s and flow_ratio (positive numbers), plus flow_dynamics (text describing the supported method and saved result). Missing measurements remain missing.
fields.observations: Optional array of {kind, status, notes, job_id?}. Kind: thread_fit, surface_finish or strength. Status: passed, failed or unverified. Notes must describe actual observations. job_id, if present, must match a succeeded slice for this project revision. Observations do not transfer to another revision.
fields.moving_parts: Describe intended relative movement, or record none.
fields.hinges: Describe hinge/pin axis and required movement, or record none.
fields.fit_requirements: Describe critical holes, pins, mating surfaces and measured clearance, or record none.
fields.load_direction: Describe load vector and mounting contacts, or record none for a nonstructural model.
fields.cosmetic_faces: Array of {name, bounds_mm: [minimum_xyz, maximum_xyz], avoid_seams?: boolean, ironing?: boolean}. Bounds use project world millimetres. Empty means no declared cosmetic regions. Re-record after geometry changes.
fields.elephant_foot_expansion_mm: Optional nonnegative measured per-side first-layer expansion. Compensation is not this measurement. Missing values use an explicitly labeled conservative budget.

example.intended_use: Threads and visible enclosure surfaces; physical acceptance not yet defined

limits: The example is an input shape, not a verified hardware or filament recipe.
Use the actual printer, each active nozzle and every assigned material. Do not copy the example's printer assumptions.
A specification URL is a user-supplied reference, not proof that the page matches the spool.
Guidance does not block existing slice tools or establish physical safety, strength or finish.
